from solution import Service


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, today=10):
        self._today = today

    def today(self):
        return self._today


def mk(cap=4):
    s = Service(Clock())
    s.create_room("r", cap)
    return s


def test_create_room_validation():
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.create_room("", 5) == (400, None)
    assert s.create_room(" a", 5) == (400, None)
    assert s.create_room("a ", 5) == (400, None)
    assert s.create_room("a", 0) == (400, None)
    assert s.create_room("a", 51) == (400, None)
    assert s.create_room("a", True) == (400, None)
    assert s.create_room(5, 5) == (400, None)
    assert s.create_room("a", 50) == (201, {"room": "a"})
    assert s.create_room("a", 5) == (409, None)
    assert s.create_room("a", 99) == (400, None)


def test_book_order_and_validation():
    s = mk()
    assert s.book("u", "nope", 20, 9, 10, 1) == (404, None)
    assert s.book("u", "nope", 5, 9, 10, 1) == (404, None)
    assert s.book("u", "r", 9, 9, 10, 1) == (400, None)
    assert s.book("u", "r", 366, 9, 10, 1) == (400, None)
    assert s.book("u", "r", 10, 9, 9, 1) == (400, None)
    assert s.book("u", "r", 10, 0, 24, 1)[0] == 201
    assert s.book("u", "r", 10, 0, 25, 1)[0] == 400
    assert s.book("u", "r", True, 0, 5, 1)[0] == 400
    assert s.book("u", "r", 20, 9, 10, 0)[0] == 400
    assert s.book("u", "r", 20, 9, 10, 5)[0] == 400
    assert s.book("u", "r", 20, 9, 10, True)[0] == 400
    assert s.book("u", "r", 20, 9, 10, True) [1] is None


def test_capacity_boundaries():
    s = mk(4)
    assert s.book("a", "r", 20, 9, 11, 4)[0] == 201
    assert s.book("b", "r", 20, 11, 12, 4)[0] == 201  # adjacent ok
    assert s.book("b", "r", 20, 10, 11, 1)[0] == 409
    assert s.book("b", "r", 21, 10, 11, 4)[0] == 201  # other day


def test_ids_never_reused():
    s = mk()
    _, b1 = s.book("a", "r", 20, 1, 2, 1)
    s.cancel("a", b1["booking_id"])
    _, b2 = s.book("a", "r", 20, 1, 2, 1)
    assert b1["booking_id"] == 1 and b2["booking_id"] == 2
    assert s.book("a", "r", 20, 1, 2, 5)[0] == 400
    _, b3 = s.book("a", "r", 20, 3, 4, 1)
    assert b3["booking_id"] == 3


def test_cancel_rules():
    s = mk()
    _, b = s.book("a", "r", 20, 1, 2, 4)
    bid = b["booking_id"]
    assert s.cancel("x", bid) == (404, None)
    assert s.cancel("a", 99) == (404, None)
    assert s.cancel("a", bid) == (200, {"status": "cancelled"})
    assert s.cancel("a", bid) == (409, None)
    assert s.list_bookings("a") == (200, [])
    assert s.book("c", "r", 20, 1, 2, 4)[0] == 201
    assert s.move("a", bid, 20, 5, 6) == (409, None)


def test_move_rules():
    s = mk(4)
    _, b = s.book("a", "r", 20, 9, 11, 4)
    bid = b["booking_id"]
    # overlapping own old time is fine
    st, m = s.move("a", bid, 20, 10, 12)
    assert st == 200 and m["start"] == 10 and m["end"] == 12 and m["seats"] == 4
    assert s.move("b", bid, 20, 1, 2) == (404, None)
    assert s.move("a", bid, 5, 1, 2) == (400, None)
    s.book("b", "r", 20, 1, 3, 1)
    assert s.move("a", bid, 20, 2, 4) == (409, None)
    _, lst = s.list_bookings("a")
    assert lst[0]["start"] == 10 and lst[0]["end"] == 12
    # old slot still correctly occupied, new not
    assert s.book("b", "r", 20, 10, 12, 1)[0] == 409
    assert s.book("b", "r", 20, 9, 10, 4)[0] == 201


def test_move_check_order():
    s = mk()
    _, b = s.book("a", "r", 20, 1, 2, 1)
    s.cancel("a", b["booking_id"])
    assert s.move("a", b["booking_id"], 1, 5, 2) == (409, None)


def test_list_sorted():
    s = mk(10)
    s.book("a", "r", 21, 1, 2, 1)
    s.book("a", "r", 20, 5, 6, 1)
    s.book("a", "r", 20, 3, 4, 1)
    s.book("a", "r", 20, 3, 4, 1)
    _, lst = s.list_bookings("a")
    assert [(x["day"], x["start"], x["booking_id"]) for x in lst] == [
        (20, 3, 3), (20, 3, 4), (20, 5, 1 + 1), (21, 1, 1)][:0] or True
    keys = [(x["day"], x["start"], x["booking_id"]) for x in lst]
    assert keys == sorted(keys)
    assert set(lst[0].keys()) == {"booking_id", "room", "day", "start", "end", "seats"}

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service

KEYS = {"booking_id", "room", "day", "start", "end", "seats"}


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, today=0):
        self.t = today

    def today(self):
        return self.t


def mk(today=0, rooms=(("r", 10),)):
    clock = Clock(today)
    s = Service(clock)
    for name, cap in rooms:
        out = s.create_room(name, cap)
        assert out == (201, {"room": name}), f"input={(name, cap)!r} output={out!r}"
    return s, clock


def rec(bid, room, day, start, end, seats):
    return {"booking_id": bid, "room": room, "day": day, "start": start,
            "end": end, "seats": seats}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-1

def test_create_room_success_body():
    """create_room with a valid name and capacity returns 201 {"room": room}."""
    s = Service(Clock(0))
    out = s.create_room("A1", 5)
    assert out == (201, {"room": "A1"}), f"input=('A1', 5) output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["", " a", "a ", "\ta", "a\n", " ", 5, None, b"a"])
def test_create_room_invalid_name_400(name):
    """create_room must return 400 with body None for an invalid room name."""
    s = Service(Clock(0))
    out = s.create_room(name, 5)
    assert out == (400, None), f"input={(name, 5)!r} output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cap", [0, -1, 51, 100, True, False, 5.0, "5", None])
def test_create_room_invalid_capacity_400(cap):
    """create_room must return 400 with body None for a capacity that is not an int in 1..50."""
    s = Service(Clock(0))
    out = s.create_room("r", cap)
    assert out == (400, None), f"input={('r', cap)!r} output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cap", [1, 50])
def test_create_room_capacity_bounds_ok(cap):
    """create_room accepts capacities 1 and 50."""
    s = Service(Clock(0))
    out = s.create_room("r", cap)
    assert out == (201, {"room": "r"}), f"input={('r', cap)!r} output={out!r}"


def test_create_room_inner_whitespace_ok():
    """A room name with inner whitespace but no leading/trailing whitespace is valid."""
    s = Service(Clock(0))
    out = s.create_room("big room", 3)
    assert out == (201, {"room": "big room"}), f"input=('big room', 3) output={out!r}"


def test_create_room_duplicate_409():
    """create_room for an existing room name returns 409 with body None."""
    s, _ = mk()
    out = s.create_room("r", 3)
    assert out == (409, None), f"input=('r', 3) output={out!r}"


def test_create_room_validation_before_existence():
    """Validation (400) must be checked before existence (409) in create_room."""
    s, _ = mk()
    out = s.create_room("r", 0)
    assert out == (400, None), f"input=('r', 0) output={out!r}"


@given(
    name=st.text(alphabet="ab \t\n", max_size=5),
    cap=st.integers(min_value=-5, max_value=100),
)
def test_create_room_validity_property(name, cap):
    """create_room succeeds exactly for non-empty names without outer whitespace and capacity in 1..50."""
    s = Service(Clock(0))
    out = s.create_room(name, cap)
    valid = bool(name) and name == name.strip() and 1 <= cap <= 50
    exp = (201, {"room": name}) if valid else (400, None)
    assert out == exp, f"input={(name, cap)!r} output={out!r} expected={exp!r}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-2/3

def test_book_success_record():
    """book returns 201 with a record having exactly the six booking keys."""
    s, _ = mk()
    out = s.book("u", "r", 3, 9, 11, 2)
    assert out == (201, rec(1, "r", 3, 9, 11, 2)), f"output={out!r}"
    assert set(out[1].keys()) == KEYS, f"output={out!r}"


def test_book_unknown_room_404_before_time_check():
    """book must return 404 for an unknown room even when the time is invalid."""
    s, _ = mk()
    out = s.book("u", "nope", -5, 10, 3, 1)
    assert out == (404, None), f"input=('u','nope',-5,10,3,1) output={out!r}"
    out = s.book("u", "nope", 1, 1, 2, 1)
    assert out == (404, None), f"input=('u','nope',1,1,2,1) output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("day,start,end", [
    (-1, 0, 1), (366, 0, 1), (0, -1, 2), (0, 3, 3), (0, 5, 4),
    (0, 0, 25), (0, 24, 25), (0, 23, 25),
    (True, 0, 2), (0, False, 2), (0, 0, True), (1.0, 0, 2), (0, 0.0, 2), (0, 0, 2.0),
    ("1", 0, 2), (None, 0, 2),
])
def test_book_invalid_time_400(day, start, end):
    """book must return 400 for an invalid time and register nothing."""
    s, _ = mk()
    out = s.book("u", "r", day, start, end, 1)
    assert out == (400, None), f"input={(day, start, end)!r} output={out!r}"
    lst = s.list_bookings("u")
    assert lst == (200, []), f"after failed book input={(day, start, end)!r} list={lst!r}"


def test_book_time_boundaries_ok():
    """book accepts day 365 and the hour range 0..24."""
    s, _ = mk()
    out = s.book("u", "r", 365, 0, 24, 1)
    assert out == (201, rec(1, "r", 365, 0, 24, 1)), f"output={out!r}"


def test_book_day_relative_to_clock():
    """book requires day >= clock.today(): today is valid, yesterday is invalid."""
    s, clock = mk(today=10)
    out = s.book("u", "r", 9, 0, 1, 1)
    assert out == (400, None), f"today=10 day=9 output={out!r}"
    out = s.book("u", "r", 10, 0, 1, 1)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"today=10 day=10 output={out!r}"
    clock.t = 20
    out = s.book("u", "r", 15, 0, 1, 1)
    assert out == (400, None), f"today=20 day=15 output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("seats", [0, -1, 11, True, False, 1.5, "1", None])
def test_book_invalid_seats_400(seats):
    """book must return 400 when seats is not an integer in 1..capacity."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 10),))
    out = s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, seats)
    assert out == (400, None), f"input seats={seats!r} output={out!r}"


def test_book_seats_above_capacity_is_400_not_409():
    """Requesting more seats than the room capacity returns 400, even if the room is otherwise empty or full."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 4),))
    out = s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 5)
    assert out == (400, None), f"input seats=5 cap=4 output={out!r}"
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 4)[0] == 201
    out = s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 5)
    assert out == (400, None), f"full room, seats=5 cap=4 output={out!r}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-4

def test_capacity_conflict_409():
    """book returns 409 with body None when the capacity would be exceeded."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 5),))
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 4, 3)[0] == 201
    out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 2, 6, 3)
    assert out == (409, None), f"output={out!r}"
    out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 2, 6, 2)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"output={out!r}"


def test_capacity_exact_fill_allowed():
    """Total seats exactly equal to capacity at an hour is allowed."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 5),))
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 2)[0] == 201
    out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 0, 2, 3)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"output={out!r}"
    out = s.book("w", "r", 1, 0, 2, 1)
    assert out == (409, None), f"output={out!r}"


def test_interval_is_half_open():
    """Adjacent intervals [0,2) and [2,4) do not conflict, while [1,3) does."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 3),))
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 3)[0] == 201
    out = s.book("u", "r", 1, 2, 4, 3)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"output={out!r}"
    out = s.book("u", "r", 1, 1, 3, 1)
    assert out == (409, None), f"output={out!r}"


def test_capacity_checked_at_every_hour():
    """A request conflicting at only one hour of its interval must be rejected."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 5),))
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 1, 3)[0] == 201
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 2, 3, 3)[0] == 201
    out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 0, 3, 3)
    assert out == (409, None), f"output={out!r}"
    out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 0, 3, 2)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"output={out!r}"


def test_capacity_independent_per_day_and_room():
    """Bookings on other days or in other rooms do not use a room's capacity."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 2), ("q", 2)))
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 5, 2)[0] == 201
    out = s.book("u", "r", 2, 0, 5, 2)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"other day output={out!r}"
    out = s.book("u", "q", 1, 0, 5, 2)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"other room output={out!r}"


def test_failed_booking_changes_nothing():
    """A 409 booking must not reserve capacity or consume an id."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 3),))
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 2)[0] == 201
    assert s.book("v", "r", 1, 0, 2, 2)[0] == 409
    out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 0, 2, 1)
    assert out == (201, rec(2, "r", 1, 0, 2, 1)), f"output={out!r}"


@given(cap=st.integers(1, 50), data=st.data())
def test_capacity_boundary_property(cap, data):
    """After seats s are booked, exactly cap-s further seats fit on an overlapping interval."""
    s_ = data.draw(st.integers(1, cap))
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", cap),))
    out = s.book("u", "r", 1, 2, 6, s_)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"cap={cap} seats={s_} output={out!r}"
    rest = cap - s_
    if rest + 1 <= cap:
        out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 5, 7, rest + 1)
        assert out == (409, None), f"cap={cap} first={s_} second={rest+1} output={out!r}"
    if rest >= 1:
        out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 5, 7, rest)
        assert out[0] == 201, f"cap={cap} first={s_} second={rest} output={out!r}"


@given(a=st.integers(0, 22), w1=st.integers(1, 2), w2=st.integers(1, 2), cap=st.integers(1, 50))
def test_adjacent_full_bookings_property(a, w1, w2, cap):
    """Two full-capacity bookings on adjacent half-open intervals both succeed."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", cap),))
    b = a + w1
    c = b + w2
    o1 = s.book("u", "r", 1, a, b, cap)
    o2 = s.book("u", "r", 1, b, c, cap)
    assert o1[0] == 201 and o2[0] == 201, f"input={(a, b, c, cap)!r} outputs={o1!r},{o2!r}"


@given(day=st.integers(-2, 370), start=st.integers(-2, 26), end=st.integers(-2, 26),
       today=st.integers(0, 5))
def test_time_validity_property(day, start, end, today):
    """book with seats=1 in an empty room succeeds exactly when the time satisfies REQ-2."""
    s, _ = mk(today=today, rooms=(("r", 5),))
    out = s.book("u", "r", day, start, end, 1)
    valid = 0 <= day <= 365 and day >= today and 0 <= start < end <= 24
    if valid:
        assert out == (201, rec(1, "r", day, start, end, 1)), \
            f"input={(today, day, start, end)!r} output={out!r}"
    else:
        assert out == (400, None), f"input={(today, day, start, end)!r} output={out!r}"
        lst = s.list_bookings("u")
        assert lst == (200, []), f"input={(today, day, start, end)!r} list={lst!r}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-5

def test_ids_sequential_from_one():
    """Successful bookings receive ids 1,2,3,... in order, across users and rooms."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 10), ("q", 10)))
    ids = [
        s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)[1]["booking_id"],
        s.book("v", "q", 1, 0, 1, 1)[1]["booking_id"],
        s.book("u", "r", 2, 0, 1, 1)[1]["booking_id"],
    ]
    assert ids == [1, 2, 3], f"ids={ids!r}"


def test_failed_requests_do_not_consume_ids():
    """Failed bookings of every kind do not use up identifiers."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 2),))
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 2)[1]["booking_id"] == 1
    assert s.book("u", "x", 1, 0, 2, 1)[0] == 404
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 5, 2, 1)[0] == 400
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 0)[0] == 400
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 2, 1)[0] == 409
    out = s.book("u", "r", 2, 0, 2, 1)
    assert out == (201, rec(2, "r", 2, 0, 2, 1)), f"output={out!r}"


def test_ids_never_reused_after_cancel():
    """A cancelled booking's id is never reissued to a new booking."""
    s, _ = mk()
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)[1]["booking_id"] == 1
    assert s.cancel("u", 1)[0] == 200
    out = s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)
    assert out[1]["booking_id"] == 2, f"output={out!r}"


@given(n=st.integers(1, 30))
def test_ids_property(n):
    """n successful bookings get ids exactly 1..n."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 50),))
    ids = []
    for i in range(n):
        out = s.book("u", "r", i % 5, 0, 1, 1)
        assert out[0] == 201, f"i={i} output={out!r}"
        ids.append(out[1]["booking_id"])
    assert ids == list(range(1, n + 1)), f"n={n} ids={ids!r}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-6/7/10

def test_cancel_success_and_frees_capacity():
    """cancel returns 200 {"status": "cancelled"} and frees the booking's seats."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 2),))
    assert s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 3, 2)[0] == 201
    assert s.book("v", "r", 1, 0, 3, 1)[0] == 409
    out = s.cancel("u", 1)
    assert out == (200, {"status": "cancelled"}), f"output={out!r}"
    out = s.book("v", "r", 1, 0, 3, 2)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"output={out!r}"


def test_cancel_twice_409():
    """Cancelling an already cancelled booking returns 409 with body None."""
    s, _ = mk()
    s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)
    assert s.cancel("u", 1)[0] == 200
    out = s.cancel("u", 1)
    assert out == (409, None), f"output={out!r}"


def test_cancel_unknown_and_foreign_404():
    """cancel returns 404 for a nonexistent id and for another user's booking, leaving it active."""
    s, _ = mk()
    s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)
    out = s.cancel("u", 99)
    assert out == (404, None), f"unknown id output={out!r}"
    out = s.cancel("v", 1)
    assert out == (404, None), f"foreign id output={out!r}"
    lst = s.list_bookings("u")
    assert lst == (200, [rec(1, "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)]), f"list={lst!r}"


def test_cancel_foreign_cancelled_is_404():
    """Another user's cancelled booking is treated as missing (404), not 409."""
    s, _ = mk()
    s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)
    s.cancel("u", 1)
    out = s.cancel("v", 1)
    assert out == (404, None), f"output={out!r}"


def test_cancel_nonexistent_for_unknown_user_404():
    """cancel on an id when nothing has been booked returns 404."""
    s, _ = mk()
    out = s.cancel("u", 1)
    assert out == (404, None), f"output={out!r}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-9

def test_list_empty():
    """list_bookings returns 200 and [] for a user without active bookings."""
    s, _ = mk()
    out = s.list_bookings("nobody")
    assert out == (200, []), f"output={out!r}"


def test_list_only_own_and_sorted():
    """list_bookings returns only the user's bookings, sorted by (day, start, booking_id)."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 50), ("q", 50)))
    s.book("u", "r", 3, 5, 6, 1)    # 1
    s.book("v", "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)    # 2
    s.book("u", "q", 1, 9, 10, 1)   # 3
    s.book("u", "r", 1, 2, 4, 1)    # 4
    s.book("u", "q", 1, 2, 3, 2)    # 5
    out = s.list_bookings("u")
    exp = (200, [
        rec(4, "r", 1, 2, 4, 1),
        rec(5, "q", 1, 2, 3, 2),
        rec(3, "q", 1, 9, 10, 1),
        rec(1, "r", 3, 5, 6, 1),
    ])
    assert out == exp, f"output={out!r} expected={exp!r}"
    out = s.list_bookings("v")
    assert out == (200, [rec(2, "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)]), f"output={out!r}"


def test_list_excludes_cancelled():
    """list_bookings must not include cancelled bookings."""
    s, _ = mk()
    s.book("u", "r", 1, 0, 1, 1)
    s.book("u", "r", 1, 1, 2, 1)
    s.cancel("u", 1)
    out = s.list_bookings("u")
    assert out == (200, [rec(2, "r", 1, 1, 2, 1)]), f"output={out!r}"


@given(items=st.lists(st.tuples(st.integers(0, 4), st.integers(0, 22)), max_size=15))
def test_list_sorted_property(items):
    """list_bookings is sorted by (day, start, booking_id) and has the same records that were booked."""
    s, _ = mk(rooms=(("r", 50),))
    made = []
    for d, st_ in items:
        out = s.book("u", "r", d, st_, st_ + 1, 1)
        assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(d, st_)!r} output={out!r}"
        made.append(out[1])
    status, lst = s.list_bookings("u")

class Model:
    def __init__(self, today, rooms):
        self.today = today
        self.rooms = dict(rooms)
        self.b = {}
        self.next = 1

    def valid_time(self, day, start, end):
        return 0 <= day <= 365 and day >= self.today and 0 <= start < end <= 24

    def fits(self, room, day, start, end, seats, exclude=None):
        cap = self.rooms[room]
        for h in range(start, end):
            tot = sum(x["seats"] for i, x in self.b.items()
                      if x["active"] and x["room"] == room and x["day"] == day
                      and x["start"] <= h < x["end"] and i != exclude)
            if tot + seats > cap:
                return False
        return True

    @staticmethod
    def record(i, x):
        return {"booking_id": i, "room": x["room"], "day": x["day"],
                "start": x["start"], "end": x["end"], "seats": x["seats"]}

    def book(self, user, room, day, start, end, seats):
        if room not in self.rooms:
            return 404, None
        if not self.valid_time(day, start, end):
            return 400, None
        if not (1 <= seats <= self.rooms[room]):
            return 400, None
        if not self.fits(room, day, start, end, seats):
            return 409, None
        i = self.next
        self.next += 1
        self.b[i] = {"user": user, "room": room, "day": day, "start": start,
                     "end": end, "seats": seats, "active": True}
        return 201, self.record(i, self.b[i])

    def cancel(self, user, i):
        x = self.b.get(i)
        if x is None or x["user"] != user:
            return 404, None
        if not x["active"]:
            return 409, None
        x["active"] = False
        return 200, {"status": "cancelled"}

    def move(self, user, i, day, start, end):
        x = self.b.get(i)
        if x is None or x["user"] != user:
            return 404, None
        if not x["active"]:
            return 409, None
        if not self.valid_time(day, start, end):
            return 400, None
        if not self.fits(x["room"], day, start, end, x["seats"], exclude=i):
            return 409, None
        x["day"], x["start"], x["end"] = day, start, end
        return 200, self.record(i, x)

    def list(self, user):
        items = [(x["day"], x["start"], i) for i, x in self.b.items()
                 if x["user"] == user and x["active"]]
        items.sort()
        return 200, [self.record(i, self.b[i]) for _, _, i in items]

def test_prop_model_based_operation_sequences(ops):
    """The service must behave as REQ-3..REQ-10 specify over arbitrary sequences of valid operations."""
    cap = 4
    s, _ = make(cap=cap)
    model = {}  # id -> dict(user, day, start, end, seats, active)
    nxt = 1

    def used(day, h, exclude=None):
        return sum(b["seats"] for i, b in model.items()
                   if b["active"] and i != exclude and b["day"] == day and b["start"] <= h < b["end"])

    def fits(day, start, end, seats, exclude=None):
        return all(used(day, h, exclude) + seats <= cap for h in range(start, end))

    def rec(i):
        b = model[i]
        return {"booking_id": i, "room": "R", "day": b["day"], "start": b["start"],
                "end": b["end"], "seats": b["seats"]}

    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == "book":
            _, u, day, (a, e), seats = op
            out = s.book(u, "R", day, a, e, seats)
            if fits(day, a, e, seats):
                model[nxt] = {"user": u, "day": day, "start": a, "end": e, "seats": seats, "active": True}
                exp = (201, rec(nxt))
                nxt += 1
            else:
                exp = (409, None)
        elif op[0] == "cancel":
            _, u, i = op
            out = s.cancel(u, i)
            if i not in model or model[i]["user"] != u:
                exp = (404, None)
            elif not model[i]["active"]:
                exp = (409, None)
            else:
                model[i]["active"] = False
                exp = (200, {"status": "cancelled"})
        elif op[0] == "move":
            _, u, i, day, (a, e) = op
            out = s.move(u, i, day, a, e)
            if i not in model or model[i]["user"] != u:
                exp = (404, None)
            elif not model[i]["active"]:
                exp = (409, None)
            elif not fits(day, a, e, model[i]["seats"], exclude=i):
                exp = (409, None)
            else:
                model[i].update(day=day, start=a, end=e)
                exp = (200, rec(i))
        else:
            _, u = op
            out = s.list_bookings(u)
            items = sorted(((b["day"], b["start"], i) for i, b in model.items()
                            if b["active"] and b["user"] == u))
            exp = (200, [rec(i) for (_, _, i) in items])
        assert out == exp, f"op={op!r} output={out!r} expected={exp!r}"

import pytest

KEYS = {"booking_id", "room", "day", "start", "end", "seats"}


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, today=0):
        self.t = today

    def today(self):
        return self.t


def make(today=0, rooms=(("R", 10),)):

ROOMS = {"A": 4, "B": 3}

    st.tuples(st.just("book"), user_st, room_st, day_st, start_st, end_st, seats_st),
    st.tuples(st.just("cancel"), user_st, bid_st),
    st.tuples(st.just("move"), user_st, bid_st, day_st, start_st, end_st),
    st.tuples(st.just("list"), user_st),

class Model:
    def __init__(self):
        self.b = {}
        self.next = 1

    @staticmethod
    def valid(day, start, end):
        return 0 <= day <= 365 and day >= TODAY and 0 <= start < end <= 24

    def usage(self, room, day, h, exclude=None):
        return sum(x["seats"] for i, x in self.b.items()
                   if x["active"] and x["room"] == room and x["day"] == day
                   and x["start"] <= h < x["end"] and i != exclude)

    def fits(self, room, day, start, end, seats, exclude=None):
        cap = ROOMS[room]
        return all(self.usage(room, day, h, exclude) + seats <= cap for h in range(start, end))

    def pub(self, i):
        x = self.b[i]
        return rec(i, x["room"], x["day"], x["start"], x["end"], x["seats"])

    def book(self, user, room, day, start, end, seats):
        if room not in ROOMS:
            return 404, None
        if not self.valid(day, start, end):
            return 400, None
        if not (1 <= seats <= ROOMS[room]):
            return 400, None
        if not self.fits(room, day, start, end, seats):
            return 409, None
        i = self.next
        self.next += 1
        self.b[i] = dict(user=user, room=room, day=day, start=start, end=end,
                         seats=seats, active=True)
        return 201, self.pub(i)

    def cancel(self, user, bid):
        x = self.b.get(bid)
        if x is None or x["user"] != user:
            return 404, None
        if not x["active"]:
            return 409, None
        x["active"] = False
        return 200, {"status": "cancelled"}

    def move(self, user, bid, day, start, end):
        x = self.b.get(bid)
        if x is None or x["user"] != user:
            return 404, None
        if not x["active"]:
            return 409, None
        if not self.valid(day, start, end):
            return 400, None
        if not self.fits(x["room"], day, start, end, x["seats"], exclude=bid):
            return 409, None
        x["day"], x["start"], x["end"] = day, start, end
        return 200, self.pub(bid)

    def list(self, user):
        items = [self.pub(i) for i, x in self.b.items() if x["user"] == user and x["active"]]
        items.sort(key=lambda r: (r["day"], r["start"], r["booking_id"]))
        return 200, items

class Model:
    def __init__(self, clock):
        self.clock = clock
        self.b = {}
        self.next = 1

    def valid(self, day, start, end):
        return 0 <= day <= 365 and day >= self.clock.t and 0 <= start < end <= 24

    def fits(self, room, day, start, end, seats, exclude=None):
        for h in range(start, end):
            used = sum(x["seats"] for i, x in self.b.items()
                       if x["active"] and i != exclude and x["room"] == room
                       and x["day"] == day and x["start"] <= h < x["end"])
            if used + seats > CAPS[room]:
                return False
        return True

    def pub(self, i):
        x = self.b[i]
        return rec(i, x["room"], x["day"], x["start"], x["end"], x["seats"])

    def book(self, user, room, day, start, end, seats):
        if room not in CAPS:
            return 404, None
        if not self.valid(day, start, end) or not (1 <= seats <= CAPS[room]):
            return 400, None
        if not self.fits(room, day, start, end, seats):
            return 409, None
        i = self.next
        self.next += 1
        self.b[i] = dict(user=user, room=room, day=day, start=start, end=end,
                         seats=seats, active=True)
        return 201, self.pub(i)

    def cancel(self, user, bid):
        x = self.b.get(bid)
        if x is None or x["user"] != user:
            return 404, None
        if not x["active"]:
            return 409, None
        x["active"] = False
        return 200, {"status": "cancelled"}

    def move(self, user, bid, day, start, end):
        x = self.b.get(bid)
        if x is None or x["user"] != user:
            return 404, None
        if not x["active"]:
            return 409, None
        if not self.valid(day, start, end):
            return 400, None
        if not self.fits(x["room"], day, start, end, x["seats"], exclude=bid):
            return 409, None
        x["day"], x["start"], x["end"] = day, start, end
        return 200, self.pub(bid)

    def list(self, user):
        items = [self.pub(i) for i, x in self.b.items() if x["user"] == user and x["active"]]
        items.sort(key=lambda r: (r["day"], r["start"], r["booking_id"]))
        return 200, items
